adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is true, it `fetch`es the sync endpoint and returns the raw `Response` without checking `response.ok` (or otherwise handling non-2xx). Callers then treat the returned value as a successful token refresh result (e.g., Google Calendar reads `res?.data`, and other integrations expect provider-specific objects), so an error HTTP status from the sync endpoint can be propagated as if it were a token response, leading to downstream failures/mis-parsing.
